release_notes:
Helix 1.2.9

  • Automated experiment naming convention (EXPYYYYMMDD_XX) with connected user detection.
  • Prevented redundant saving and new code generation on already saved/opened experiments.
  • Fixed automatic dirty state detection to eliminate false overwrite prompts on GWL generation and Fluent execution.
  • Preserved dynamic columns and fixed JSON type coercion across experiment models.
